title: 路记得
logline: 跑足三十年长途货运的退休司机完成最后一次出车，将卡车钥匙交给学徒，十镜凝练公路人生，传递“路会记得每一个跑完它的人”的核心理念，最终落点至轮胎产品

shots.narrationEn: This is the last load I'll secure.
shots.visual: Dawn freight yard, gray-haired truck driver checks the cargo tied in the trailer.
shots.ttsDirection: 语速偏缓，情绪沉静带淡淡感慨，『最后一次』重读，后接轻微停顿

shots.narrationEn: This road out of town, I've driven it for 30 years.
shots.visual: Truck drives past the suburban toll gate at sunrise, driver's calloused hands steady on the steering wheel.
shots.ttsDirection: 语速舒缓，情绪怀旧悠远，『三十年』重读，气息平稳绵长

shots.visual: Truck cruises on the open highway, a weathered mile marker marked "1200KM" flashes past the side window.
shots.ttsDirection: 语速平稳，情绪释然带暖意，『都记得我』重读，尾音轻放

shots.narrationZh: 服务区的泡面，还是那个味。
shots.narrationEn: The instant noodles at the rest stop still taste the same.
shots.visual: Noon rest stop, driver sits alone on the truck step eating a bowl of instant noodles, a dented old thermos placed beside him.
shots.ttsDirection: 语速偏缓，情绪落寞中带暖意，『那个味』重读，气息带回味感

shots.narrationEn: Rainy roads are slippery, drive slow.
shots.visual: Heavy rain pours on the windshield, wipers swipe back and forth rapidly, driver's focused eyes stare at the wet road ahead.
shots.ttsDirection: 语速沉稳，情绪关切郑重，『慢点开』重读，气息下沉

shots.narrationEn: I've driven this night road thousands of times.
shots.visual: Night rainstorm, truck's bright headlights cut through the dark wet asphalt, a small family car passes by in the opposite lane.
shots.ttsDirection: 语速平稳，情绪坦然笃定，『几千遍』重读，气息平稳无起伏

shots.narrationEn: Dawn breaks, and the cargo arrives.
shots.visual: Early morning after rain, truck pulls into the destination freight yard, light mist hangs over the parked cargo containers.
shots.ttsDirection: 语速偏缓，情绪释然带轻松，『到了』重读，尾音轻收

shots.visual: Young apprentice driver walks up to the truck, old man hands him the truck key with a gentle smile.
shots.ttsDirection: 语速沉稳，情绪郑重带不舍，『交给你了』重读，气息微沉

shots.narrationZh: 路会记得每一个跑完它的人。
shots.narrationEn: The road remembers everyone who finishes the drive.
shots.visual: Apprentice gets in the driver's seat, starts the truck and drives away slowly, old man waves standing by the roadside.
shots.ttsDirection: 语速平稳，情绪释然欣慰，『每一个』重读，气息悠远绵长

shots.narrationZh: 好轮胎，陪你跑完每段路。
shots.narrationEn: Quality tires, with you on every road.
shots.visual: Close-up of the truck's rugged all-terrain tire rolling on the highway, brand logo clearly printed on the tread, product tagline appears below.
shots.ttsDirection: 语速偏缓，情绪温暖笃定，『每段路』重读，尾音带暖意
